name: Issue 5609: Expert Elementalist raises melee and spell hit chance by 3%
contract: Expert Elementalist 807505 (Glyphic, row 3 col 7, level 15) effect 1 is aura 333
SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3, identical in the server Spell.dbc,
the live client patch and the snapshot; AscensionDB shows 'Unknown 3' and coatavern 'Aura 333 (value: 3)'.
HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll feeds m_modMeleeHitChance, m_modRangedHitChance and m_modSpellHitChance, which
Unit::MeleeSpellMissChance and Unit::MagicSpellHitResult read. Expected: learning the talent raises both melee
and spell hit chance by 3 points and unlearning it removes both. This covers the Runemaster's melee side,

steps.label: Melee hit chance rises by 3 points
Spell hit chance rises by 3 points
